title: Mega Fun Park
specs: Multiple trampoline lanes, dodgeball, basketball dunk stations, ninja warrior and ropes courses
Arcade with classic and virtual reality games
Must be 16+ years for general employment, 21+ for management (not guest requirement)
All guests over 2 years old who use attractions must purchase a ticket

blurb: Mega Fun Park offers trampolines, dodgeball, basketball dunk stations, ninja warrior course, elevated ropes course, soft play zone, tube slide, climbing walls, inflatables, mini bowling, and interactive projection games. The park includes an arcade with classic and virtual reality games. Party packages include private rooms, food, and party hosts.
tags: Party Package - All we need is fun
extraNote: Outside food and drinks not allowed except outside cakes and desserts for parties · Waivers required and valid for 12 months · No refunds if fewer guests attend than expected for parties · Party rooms are wheelchair accessible; some park areas are not
